candidates.explanation: The URL for the new-email verification mail is built with the '/confirm-email' path, the same as the sign-up activation mail (userSignUp). The frontend therefore calls the sign-up confirm endpoint (auth/email/confirm) instead of auth/email/confirm/new. That endpoint can't process the new-email JWT payload, so the email change never completes. The path should be '/confirm-new-email'.

fix.description: In confirmNewEmail, build the URL with '/confirm-new-email' instead of '/confirm-email'.
